ana (PM): quick heads-up — ByteCloud asked for two things in tomorrow's sync: a per-route cost breakdown in the Console and tracing hooks that surface third-party RPC spans. they want a launch commitment. can we sketch acceptance criteria by EOW?
kevin (Eng): high level: cost breakdown = feasible at route aggregation level. per-token attribution per user is expensive and touches billing pipeline. tracing hooks require small SDK changes (grpc/http interceptors) + sampling policy. main risk = QPS/latency overhead.
ella (Customer Success): ByteCloud is our top DS enterprise — they said this is blocking their go-live with Dedicated. they want: 1) obvious route-level cost view in UI, 2) quick link from route to traces for recent errors, 3) ability to filter by model and time range.
maria (SRE): agree with kevin. we should avoid full per-request token accounting in MVP. propose: compute route-level token aggregates from existing metrics pipeline (rollup hourly) and show estimated USD. tracing: default 10% sample, 100% capture for error traces for first 48h after deploy. need to validate storage cost impact.
sam (Design): sketch idea: 2-panel layout — left: top routes by cost (sparkline + estimated $/hour), right: traces for selected route with quick filters (error/high-latency). include a lightweight 'why this cost' flyout that links sample request flows and model/seq-length distribution. i'll drop a mock by EOD. :art:
kevin (Eng): engineering splits I see: A) metrics aggregation + new Console UI surface B) tracing hook SDK + backend ingestion C) rollout/FF + canary dashboards. rough T-shirt: A = 2w, B = 2w, C = 1w (parallelize A & B). devtime assumes we re-use current metrics pipeline and skip per-request token joins.
antelemetry-bot: new dashboard template generated: dashboard.id=dg-98011 link=https://console.redwood/internal/dash/dg-98011
ana (PM): proposed acceptance criteria (MVP):
- Console shows top 20 routes by estimated token cost over selected window, sortable by USD/hr and token count.
- Route detail includes sample traces, quick filter by error and latency > p95, and link to model & quantization profile used.
- Cost numbers are derived from hourly rollups with clear "estimated" badge and documented method in tooltip.
- Tracing hooks: SDK interceptors available for gRPC/http (node, python) and backend accepts sampled spans. default sample=10%, but errors force-sampled for 48h.
- Performance: adding tracing + route cost UI does not increase P95 generation latency by >5ms on average in our staging bench.
- Rollout: gated behind feature-flag and canary to 5% of customers, with auto-fallback to "metrics-only" if backend sampling lag > 2m.
kevin (Eng): +1 to criteria. note: "errors force-sampled 48h" needs a short TTL impl in headend; doable but add ~1d infra work. I'll add that to B.
maria (SRE): suggest an operational SLO to gate launch: ingestion lag for spans < 30s for 90th pct on canary. if we miss, abort rollout. also need quota guard for span storage.
elle (Customer Success): from customer's POV, we need a short FAQ + expected differences vs exact billing (they asked if this will be invoice-accurate). answer should be: estimated only, invoice still authoritative. i'll draft the customer note.
sam (Design): small ask — add a compact CSV export for top routes (for finance). keeps customer happy.
kevin (Eng): implementation notes:
- Metric names we'll expose: `redwood.route.tokens.hourly_total`, `redwood.route.estimated_usd.hourly`
- Trace attribute to link: `route_id`, `model_name`, `seq_len_bucket`
- SDK: add interceptors + env var `REDWOOD_TRACE_SAMPLING` for override
- Rollup job: reuse hourly aggregator, add route label join (no per-request join).
code snippet: ```
// example trace attr
span.setAttribute('route_id', route.id)
span.setAttribute('model_name', model.name)
```
kana (PM): trade-offs callout for roadmap doc: do not promise per-user billing accuracy or per-request invoice parity. call this "route-level visibility" in comms.
maria (SRE): plan for smoke tests: create synthetic spike with 50k requests/min to ensure rollup and span ingestion hold. schedule in staging.
kevin (Eng): deps: Design mock + Console owner signoff (sam), SDK owners (eng-ml), infra quota change (eng-infra). I'll create tickets and estimate sprint allocation.
nana (PM): decision checklist for EOW:
1) agree MVP acceptance criteria (above) — thumbs?
2) sam shares mocks by EOD
3) kevin files implementation epic and links to canary plan
4) ella drafts customer FAQ and go/no-go script for sales
5) maria schedules staging smoke test
please react with :thumbsup: for approvals or call out blockers.
kevin (Eng): :thumbsup:
maria (SRE): :thumbsup:
sam (Design): :thumbsup: will try to get mock early
ella (Customer Success): :thumbsup: will prep FAQ
telemetry-bot: ticket created: TICKET-4123 epic=console-route-cost-traces link=https://redwood/tracker/TICKET-4123
ana (PM): thanks — i'll compile and send to ByteCloud after we have the mocks + epic. if anything changes flag here.
kevin (Eng): one more operational note — consider a toggle to only compute USD estimates for Dedicated clusters (so hosted free/beta customers don't trigger rollups).
maria (SRE): good idea. add to epic.
nana (PM): closing — will update thread once mocks/epic live. cheers everyone! :rocket:
